title: Preimage of a standard chart under a morphism to projective space given by sections
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $n\ge0$, and $\mathbf P^n_S=S\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ with $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}=\operatorname{Proj}(\mathbf Z[T_0,\dots,T_n])$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], projections $q_n=\mathrm{pr}_1$ and $\mathrm{pr}_2:\mathbf P^n_S\to\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$. For $j\in\{0,\dots,n\}$ let $D_+(T_j)_S=\mathrm{pr}_2^{-1}(D_+(T_j))$, and for $l\in\{0,\dots,n\}$ let $u_{l/j}\in\Gamma(D_+(T_j)_S,\mathcal O)$ be the pullback by $\mathrm{pr}_2$ of the function $T_l/T_j\in\Gamma(D_+(T_j),\mathcal O)=\mathbf Z[T_0/T_j,\dots,T_n/T_j]$. Let $g:Y\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, $\mathcal L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], $s_0,\dots,s_n\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L)$ global sections generating $\mathcal L$, and $\varphi=\varphi_{g,(\mathcal L,(s_i))}:Y\to\mathbf P^n_S$ the morphism of [def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections]. For a global section $s$ of $\mathcal L$ write $Y_s=\{y\in Y: s(y)\neq0 \text{ in } \mathcal L_y\otimes\kappa(y)\}$ (an open set on which $s$ trivializes $\mathcal L$). Then for every $j$: (i) $\varphi^{-1}(D_+(T_j)_S)=Y_{s_j}$; (ii) for every $l$, $\varphi^*(u_{l/j})\in\Gamma(Y_{s_j},\mathcal O)$ is the unique function $a$ with $s_l|_{Y_{s_j}}=a\,s_j|_{Y_{s_j}}$ (written $s_l/s_j$).

source.place: Constructions, Lemma (Tag 01NE, label lemma-projective-space) and its proof via Lemma 01NA (label lemma-apply): the morphism attached to (L, psi) maps Y_{psi(f)} to D_+(f) by the ring map on degree-zero parts; Section (Tag 01MM, label section-invertible-on-proj) for the construction

proof.text: *Reduction to $\psi$.* Write $\psi=\psi_{(\mathcal L,(s_i))}:Y\to\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$. By [def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections], $\mathrm{pr}_2\circ\varphi=\psi$. Hence $\varphi^{-1}(D_+(T_j)_S)=\varphi^{-1}(\mathrm{pr}_2^{-1}(D_+(T_j)))=(\mathrm{pr}_2\circ\varphi)^{-1}(D_+(T_j))=\psi^{-1}(D_+(T_j))$, and, since the maps on sections of a composite of morphisms of schemes compose, $\varphi^*(u_{l/j})=\varphi^\sharp(\mathrm{pr}_2^\sharp(T_l/T_j))=(\mathrm{pr}_2\circ\varphi)^\sharp(T_l/T_j)=\psi^\sharp(T_l/T_j)$ in $\Gamma(\psi^{-1}(D_+(T_j)),\mathcal O_Y)$, where $u_{l/j}=\mathrm{pr}_2^\sharp(T_l/T_j)$ by definition [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. So (i) and (ii) are the statements $\psi^{-1}(D_+(T_j))=Y_{s_j}$ and $\psi^\sharp(T_l/T_j)=s_l/s_j$ about $\psi$.

source.place: Constructions, paragraph after Definition 01NF (the morphism to $\mathbf P^n_S$ is the pair of the structure morphism and the morphism to $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$)

proof.text: *The datum of $\psi$ and the charts of $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$.* By [lem-weil-pbc-projective-space-functor-of-points] there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules $\alpha:\psi^*\mathcal O(1)\to\mathcal L$ with $\alpha(\psi^*T_i)=s_i$ for all $i$, where $\mathcal O(1)$ is the twisting sheaf of $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ with its global sections $T_0,\dots,T_n$, and $\psi^*T_i\in\Gamma(Y,\psi^*\mathcal O(1))$ is the image of $T_i$ under the unit $\mathcal O(1)\to\psi_*\psi^*\mathcal O(1)$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. By [lem-weil-pbc-projective-space-twisting-sheaf-charts], $\mathcal O(1)$ is invertible, $D_+(T_j)=\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[T_0/T_j,\dots,T_n/T_j]$, $D_+(T_j)$ is the non-vanishing locus $(\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z})_{T_j}$ of the section $T_j$, and $T_l|_{D_+(T_j)}=(T_l/T_j)\cdot T_j|_{D_+(T_j)}$ in $\mathcal O(1)(D_+(T_j))$.

source.place: Constructions, Lemma 01NE and its proof (special case of Lemma 01NA: $\psi(T_i)=s_i$, $d=1$), Lemma 01N8 (label lemma-converse-construction: the pair $(\varphi,\alpha)$ with $\alpha:\varphi^*\mathcal O(d)\cong\mathcal L$ compatible with $\psi$); Lemmas 01MV, 01MA for the charts

proof.text:
*(i): $\psi^{-1}(D_+(T_j))=Y_{s_j}$.* Let $y\in Y$, $x=\psi(y)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-invertible-pullback-tensor] (3), the fibre of $\psi^*\mathcal O(1)$ at $y$ is $\mathcal O(1)(x)\otimes_{\kappa(x)}\kappa(y)$ and $(\psi^*T_j)(y)=T_j(x)\otimes1$. Since $\kappa(x)	o\kappa(y)$ is a field extension, $\kappa(y)$ is a free $\kappa(x)$-module and $v\otimes1
e0$ for every nonzero $v\in\mathcal O(1)(x)$; so $(\psi^*T_j)(y)
e0$ iff $T_j(x)
e0$, i.e. $Y_{\psi^*T_j}=\psi^{-1}((\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z})_{T_j})$ (this is Stacks Modules, Remark 0H78). The isomorphism $\alpha$ induces, for each $y$, an isomorphism of stalks $(\psi^*\mathcal O(1))_y	o\mathcal L_y$ of $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$-modules, which maps $\mathfrak m_y(\psi^*\mathcal O(1))_y$ onto $\mathfrak m_y\mathcal L_y$ and $(\psi^*T_j)_y$ to $s_{j,y}$; hence $Y_{\psi^*T_j}=Y_{\alpha(\psi^*T_j)}=Y_{s_j}$. With step 2, $\psi^{-1}(D_+(T_j))=\psi^{-1}((\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z})_{T_j})=Y_{\psi^*T_j}=Y_{s_j}$. With step 1 this is (i).

source.place: Constructions, proof of Lemma 01N8, uniqueness part: 'By the commutativity of the diagrams in the lemma we have that the inverse images of $D_+(f)$ under both $\varphi$ and $\varphi'$ are equal to $Y_{\psi(f)}$' (here $f=T_j$, $\psi(f)=s_j$); Modules, Remark 0H78 (label remark-pullback-s-open); Lemma 01MV for $D_+(f)$ as a non-vanishing locus

proof.text: *(ii): $\psi^\sharp(T_l/T_j)=s_l/s_j$.* Put $V=Y_{s_j}=\psi^{-1}(D_+(T_j))$ (step 3) and $a=\psi^\sharp(T_l/T_j)\in\mathcal O_Y(V)$. The unit $\eta:\mathcal O(1)\to\psi_*\psi^*\mathcal O(1)$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is a map of $\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}}$-modules, where $(\psi_*\psi^*\mathcal O(1))(D_+(T_j))=(\psi^*\mathcal O(1))(V)$ is an $\mathcal O(D_+(T_j))$-module through $\psi^\sharp$, and it commutes with restriction to opens. Applying it over $D_+(T_j)$ to the identity $T_l|_{D_+(T_j)}=(T_l/T_j)\cdot T_j|_{D_+(T_j)}$ of step 2 gives $(\psi^*T_l)|_V=a\cdot(\psi^*T_j)|_V$ in $(\psi^*\mathcal O(1))(V)$. Applying the $\mathcal O_Y$-linear $\alpha$ gives $s_l|_V=a\cdot s_j|_V$ in $\mathcal L(V)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-nonvanishing-section-trivializes] (with $s=s_j$, the open $V=Y_{s_j}$ and $t=s_l|_V$) there is exactly one $a'\in\mathcal O_Y(V)$ with $s_l|_V=a'\,s_j|_V$, namely $s_l/s_j$; hence $a=s_l/s_j$, and this unique function exists. With step 1, $\varphi^*(u_{l/j})=\psi^\sharp(T_l/T_j)=s_l/s_j$, which is (ii). (In the source's terms: since $D_+(T_j)=\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[T_l/T_j]$ is affine, $\psi|_{Y_{s_j}}:Y_{s_j}\to D_+(T_j)$ corresponds to the ring map $T_l/T_j\mapsto s_l/s_j$, Schemes Lemma 01I1; not needed for the statement.)

source.place: Constructions, proof of Lemma 01N8: construction ('a ring map $\psi_{(f)}:S_{(f)}\to\Gamma(Y_s,\mathcal O_Y)$ by mapping the fraction $a/f^n$ to $\psi(a)/s^n$', with $x\mapsto x/s$ the inverse of multiplication by $s$, Modules Lemma 01CY) and uniqueness part ('$\psi^d_\varphi(x)=\varphi^\sharp(x/f^n)\psi^d_\varphi(f^n)$ over $Y_{\psi(f)}$ ... we deduce that $\varphi^\sharp(x/f^n)=(\varphi')^\sharp(x/f^n)$'), with $d=n=1$, $f=T_j$, $x=T_l$

split_report.summary: Split by one level following Stacks Constructions Lemma 01N8 (uniqueness part and construction of $\varphi_f$), specialized by 01NA/01NE to $\mathbf Z[T_0,\dots,T_n]$, $d=1$. Step 1 reduces to $\psi=\mathrm{pr}_2\circ\varphi$ (elementary). Step 2 collects the datum $\alpha:\psi^*\mathcal O(1)\cong\mathcal L$, $\psi^*T_i\mapsto s_i$ from lem-weil-pbc-projective-space-functor-of-points (whose statement gives exactly this; it does not describe $\psi$ on charts, so the chart description is derived here from that defining property, as 01N8's uniqueness proof does) and the chart facts of $\mathcal O(1)$ (new node lem-weil-pbc-projective-space-twisting-sheaf-charts). Step 3 proves (i) by pulling back the non-vanishing locus (fibre formula (3) of the reviewed lem-weil-pbc-invertible-pullback-tensor; Stacks Remark 0H78) and transporting along $\alpha$. Step 4 proves (ii) by pulling back $T_l=(T_l/T_j)T_j$ and the uniqueness of $s_l/s_j$ (new node lem-weil-pbc-nonvanishing-section-trivializes, Modules 01CY). Statement kept; def-weil-residue-field added to stmt_deps ($\kappa(y)$ in the definition of $Y_s$). Mathlib: Proj.fromOfGlobalSections_preimage_basicOpen / fromOfGlobalSections_resLE are the case $\mathcal L=\mathcal O_Y$ only; source repository ProjectiveSpace/OfSections.lean (homOfSections, homOfSections_preimage_standardOpen, homOfSections_resLE_comp_toProjInt_resLE, sorry-free) likewise covers only $\mathcal L=\mathcal O_Y$ and does not state this node.
